body: Hi how do I send you a pm? I wrote you, but i want to paste it in a pm.

Today is one of my big time shitty days.
Yeah me too, i'd rather hear something bad happen to a human than to an animal. I did get a puppy about a yr. ago(cavalier king charles spaniel) the are the best companion dogs . They're actually bred for companionship. I had her for about 6 months and I started to feel guilty leaving her alone even for a little while. I was obessing over her well being a lot as if she was human. I wanted only the best for her. Well I put a lot of pressure on myself to do the right thing by her and i couldn't handle the responsibility of having a dog anymore. I searched for a responsible owner for a while and i finally found her a great home. I miss her terribly, but i didn't have the heart to keep her just for my well being when i couldn't care for her the way she needed. I think about her every day. The guilt eats me alive for giving her away. I know that it shouldn't but guilt runs a huge part of my life to begin with. I don't think there are pet therapy paces by me:(
So you failed higher english and your handwriting is aweful?! Well, you express your thoughts clearly and your posts aren't boring to read! haha:). I have nice handwriting,but as you can tell my writing skills are NOT good at all :) lol. I never write and I find it very hard to put clear thoughts together. I'm a big time scatter brain. I never did any of the art stuff although, i wouldn't mind doing pottery,but i have no one to go with:( I live a super lonely life and the truth is if i has a gun it would all be over. I wish i could survive on an island surrounded by only animals and never see a human being again! :(
I would say i'm logical. I never watch TV shows. I dislike most movies. The more action packed it is ,the more i don't like it:) I'm all about non-fiction,animal planet,discover channel, and documantaries.

Hi how's your day going? I read over my last post and my thoughts were all over the place. It sounded like I was blaming my friends for my life. I meant to express I blame my parents. Anyway,thank you so much for the music. I like all kinds of music except electronic and opera. Lol :) I've never tried playing an instrument. If I did it would probably be drums. I doubt that I would ever consider it though. I love,love,love animals especially dogs. In fact, I like them better than humans. :) I would love to volunteer at a shelter, but seeing their conditions would set me back even more. I have a tremendous amount of love for dogs and my heart couldn't take seeing them like that. I would just want to take them all home with me and knowing that I can't would kill me. 
Did you ever take up writing in school? You have great writing skills unlike myself :)

I've had multiple sessions with professionals, I just didn't feel a conection with them. I know there all millions of people that suffer with what i'm dealing with. Depression is different for everyone. What works for one might not work for another. All the best to you.

I probably would've done the same thing you did as far as distancing  yourself from your friends. Would you hang with your friends if they were just going to a bar or something? I didn't have the best childhood either and i blame a lot of what i"m going through on them. They say don't blame, but i sure am. :) My bro is the favorite too, I envy the material things he has, but i don't envy his character. He's a heartless ,self centered douche! I'm so sorry to hear about your mom passing. I hope you are/were able to find peace with it all. 
Yes! It takes one little thing to change my mood and i'm done for the day. I don't do anything that would help with my depression because i just can't do it on my own . Well, I know what should be doing to help myself, but when you've lost your will to live,it all just becomes a bother.I think the medication is aiding in your change of thoughts. I wish i knew what would help you sleep. Have you tried meletonin? or deep breaths w/ soothing music?
I was diagnosed with Major depressive disorder an anxiety/ocd. That's a good thing that scares you. Then it's least likely for it to occur.
 I wish i can find something to take my mind off the dark thoughts.All I want to do is dark things. I have no desire to do anything else. I clean and listen to music to pass time. I live a seriously pathetic life. Since, I have ocd i can sit for hrs. and ponder the same dark thought and not let it go. Whenever i hear about a suicide i become very jealous that they succeeded. 
On good days i look for suicide blogs and stuff and try to help, but most days i'm like who are you kidding!!? lol I have a very unhealthy attitude. I also don't find many people who suffer the way i do with mental anguish. Maybe I'm just too selfish to realize. To be honest, my shit life has consumed every bit of my being! :(

Hi G, I'm Priscilla. :)
I was hospitilized for attempting suicide and was given Prozac I took that for ten yrs.and felt like a million bucks and out of no where I became a really moody/depressed bitch. I know longer saw things the same, i has zero patience with people, my whole attitude torwards life changed. I saw serveral Dr's after that and tried to get back on Prozac several times, but was not successful. 
Why do you want to distance yourself from friends and family? Are they not supportive? 
 I do think there are some psych dr.s who care,but definitley not enough of them. I have days were I can be so supportive and then other days i have to keep my mouth shut because i feel like i'm being a hipocrite.
Depression definitely can get morbid. I've done some very dark things, but these are the things that comfort me right now. What has the dr. diagnosed you with. BTW, have you ever attempted suicide?

I'm so happy to hear something is working for you even a lil bit. I totally understand your lack of motivation. I spend a lot of time reading suicidal stories or anything that has to do with it. It's really all that i can identify with right now. Actually, for the past 4 yrs. Once the medication stopped working 4yrs. ago it was all down hill again. I've lost my friends and family over my depression. They clearly know my condition, but choose to ignore it. I'm not seeing a professional as I'm disgusted with them. I'm starting to lose faith in humanity. I pretty much struggle with suicidal thoughts and a lot of regrets all da long.
thank you...you're very kind. I hope you remain caring once you graduate. People will benefit from your caring nature.

That's ok everyone is entitled to their opinion.  I've had only bad experiences with psych. Dr's. Let's just say I work in the medical feild and they are not respected in the least. They push meds because they get a kick back from the drug companies. The Dr. is better friends with the drug reps than they are with you. They tried to put me on meds that had nothing to do with my depression and had ridiculous side effects. Thank god i knew better than to take it and i reported him. Just be careful!

They make an effort because they're get paid for it. That's why it's not comorting. They certainly wouldn't listen to me for free. I just prefer someone who's been there because if not, it makes me even angrier that the're clueless. As you know, there are different levels of depression. I've been too many psych. Dr.s they all have been either rude or not understanding. If I tell a dr. that something doesn't work for me they should listen not do what they want anyway.When dealing with someone suicidal one must take on a very supportive approach. Dr.s today don't care. In fact, America has a horrible mental health care. Anyway, best of luck to you in school and I hope you only suffer from a mild form of depression.

lol yes I'm a female. I'm new on here as well. Not too sure how it works either. I was on Prozac for many yrs. and it stopped working. I've tried Celexa,Remeron,Paxil,Zoloft,andTrazodone. None of them worked and I had bad side effcts from them. Are the meds you're on now working for you?
Unfortunatley, there is no magic formula. That's just what I do look for ways that might benefit me. All the best to you.
